subject.title: fix: antml:/mm: namespaced tool-call XML leaks into chat replies (#97750)

question: Should OpenClaw expose `preserveCodeRegions` as a public `stripPlainTextToolCallBlocks` SDK option as part of this bug fix?
rationale: The core leak repair is a clear bug fix, but the public plugin SDK option is durable API surface and repository policy treats SDK compatibility direction as maintainer-owned.

options.title: Accept the SDK opt-in
options.body: Keep the additive option because it preserves the strict default while giving plugin callers an explicit way to preserve Markdown code examples.

options.title: Keep code-awareness internal
options.body: Remove the public option and leave code-aware preservation only on internal delivery paths to avoid expanding the SDK contract in this repair branch.

options.title: Pause for a narrower branch
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the sanitizer and repair changes without any SDK API expansion on this branch.

recommendation.title: Accept the SDK opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the additive option because it preserves the strict default while giving plugin callers an explicit way to preserve Markdown code examples.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history places steipete closest to both shared visible-text sanitization and provider-stream SDK seam direction.
